title: イングリッシュトピックス2
subtitle: English Topics 2
courseType:
English Language Program
English Language Courses
educationalGoal: In English Topics 2, students will acquire communication skills in English by studying various topics, English expressions, sentence structures, and vocabulary. They will develop effective language learning techniques.
advice: The class will be conducted using the following topics: Live Escalate Book 1 Unit 7 Eating Out Unit 8 At the Supermarket Unit 9 Hobbies Unit 10 Shop Till You Drop Unit 11 Going on Vacation Unit 12 Sports Each class consists of active learning activities such as pair work, group work, and English games. Before each class, students must check Moodle and the e-syllabus for any homework or other materials needed for class.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar and vocabulary are necessary.

activityGoals.body: Listen and understand the overall content of each unit.
Understand the targeted grammar, vocabulary, and expressions in each unit and use them in simple sentences.
Comprehend spoken questions generated from each unit and produce appropriate verbal responses.
Work collaboratively with classmates to improve English communication skills.
Develop a habit of studying autonomously through online assignments.

achievementLevels.ideal: - Listen and understand the content of the unit perfectly. - Understand the basic English grammar, and the meaning of important vocabulary and expressions in each unit, and use or apply them appropriately. - Comprehend spoken questions generated from each unit and produce appropriate verbal responses promptly and accurately. - Work collaboratively with classmates to improve English communication skills. - Develop a habit of studying autonomously.
achievementLevels.standard: - Listen and understand the overall content of the unit. - Understand the basic English grammar, and the meaning of important vocabulary and expressions in each unit, and, though not perfectly, use them to form simple sentences. - Comprehend spoken questions generated from each unit and produce adequate verbal responses. - Work collaboratively with classmates to improve English communication skills. - Develop a habit of studying autonomously.

lessons.assignments: Review Unit 7, 8, & 9 Practice for Oral Assessment 1
